title: gpu window outranks preview placeholders

commit.merge_subject: merge: gpu window outranks preview placeholders

description:
The GPU preview path's serving steady state had no arm in
PreviewSurface's display when: with a published frame and a serving
window (gpuWindowServing=true), the first arm's !gpuWindowServing
guard is false, so the state fell through to the placeholder arms —
the RENDERING spinner during playback (stateOf keeps flipping
RENDERING between frames because renderInFlight outranks hasFrame
there), the PREPARING spinner+text during the session-open window,
and the idle "No preview yet" text when paused (stateOf=FRAME).
The GPU-served preview therefore never showed a clean frame through
the placeholder layer even while its render trace read healthy —
the state machine advanced internally (the frame publishes; the
scope strip reads it) and the display layer discarded the verdict.

Owner symptoms mapped (2026-11-15 report): the spinner/text
alternation over a serving window at ~1 FPS cadence is t
